name: sensitive-scanner
description: Enterprise-grade local sensitive information scanner built with Electron, Vue 3 and TypeScript.

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/electron/main.js && electron dist-electron/electron/main.js"
scripts.build:electron: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-electron',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && cp electron/preload.cjs dist-electron/electron/preload.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac --win
